skills.name: Emberglow
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: Celestial Light
skills.desc:
With 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
If another character is switched in during the 3rd hit, Pyrois automatically performs the 4th hit off-field.
Each hit consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence. Character is invulnerable during the 3rd and 4th hits.

skills.name: Twilight
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Sunrise
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick slash forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: First Light
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Performs a forward spinning slash, dealing Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more , hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Duskguard
skills.desc:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Launches a series of attacks against the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Return to Daylight
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ironhide Behemoth
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Performs a forward thrust attack, dealing Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Fading Rays
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a rush attack, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: Sun's Halo
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly charges forward and performs a series of consecutive attacks, dealing massive Ether DMG.
If hit by an enemy attack during the charge, triggers a Perfect Block effect, nullifying the damage and increasing the move's Interrupt Level to that of a Heavy Defensive Assist.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assault Directive
skills.desc:
When an Ultimate or EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo is used, Phaethon performs an assist attack, dealing Ether DMG.
This effect can trigger once every 2.5s, and is guaranteed to trigger when using an Ultimate.

skills.name: Ceremonial March
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a coordinated attack with Phaethon, dealing massive Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Total Annihilation
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above Blasting, press [Ultimate] and select the upper branch to activate:
After charging, performs a downward slash, dealing massive Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Triumphant Return
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above Blasting, press [Ultimate] and select the lower branch to activate:
Releases an energy burst in the surrounding area, dealing massive Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Unbound Swordstorm
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above Blasting, press [Ultimate] and select the left branch to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Eternal Imprisonment
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above Blasting, press [Ultimate] and select the right branch to activate:
Gathers energy ahead before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive Ether DMG.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Radiant Chariot
skills.desc:
Upon entering battle, Pyrois gains 30 Solar Prominence. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
Landing different attacks on enemies grants a certain amount of Solar Prominence, and Pyrois also gains 0.5 Solar Prominence every second while in combat, up to a max of 60.
When Pyrois uses different Ultimates, they gain the following effects:
Upper Branch - Ultimate: Total Annihilation: Gain 30 Solar Prominence and enter the Mirage state. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals 40% increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies, and with 30 or more Solar Prominence hold [Basic Attack] during the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light. This effect lasts 21s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Lower Branch - Ultimate: Triumphant Return: Enter the state. While in the Sunflare state, Energy Generation Rate increases by 15%, and DMG dealt increases by 20%/23.4%/26.8%/30.2%/33.6%/37%/40%, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack grants 10 Solar Prominence. This effect lasts 200s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Left Branch - Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm: Heavy attacks that hit enemies in the Contamination state deal 450%/525%/600%/675%/750%/825%/900% of ATK as additional DMG.
Right Branch - Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment: Heavy attacks that hit Stunned enemies trigger the Totalize effect, dealing 1125%/1312%/1499%/1686%/1873%/2060%/2250% of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating this skill, the Stun duration of all currently Stunned enemies is extended by 3s. When the Finishing Move hits, the enemy's Stun state ends.
rows: On selecting Ultimate: Triumphant Return, during Sunflare state, DMG increases
On selecting Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm, heavy attacks deal additional DMG
On selecting Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment, heavy attacks trigger Totalize on Stunned enemies, deal additional DMG

skills.name: Glorious Legion
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Pyrois' CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
Using a Chain Attack grants 300 Decibels.

cons.name: Shadows of Twilight Past
cons.desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Pyrois gains 1,000 Decibels.
This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. CRIT Rate increases by 8 %.

cons.name: Blazing Cavalry
cons.desc:
Using Ultimate: Triumphant Return grants 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s.
Pyrois's Decibel limit increases by 1,000.

cons.name: Chains of Fate
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Balefire Horizon
cons.desc:
When Pyrois triggers a Perfect Block with EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo, immediately gain shield equal to 8% of Max HP, lasting 10s.
Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Pyrois deals 10% extra Daze while shielded.

cons.name: Youthful Guardian
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
